Those records feed model capability checks, including whether the Codex extension exposes vision-dependent tools. ```mermaid flowchart LR A[Saved provider model entry] --> B[Config materialization] C[Plugin catalog metadata] --> B B --> D[Runtime model record] D --> E[Capability checks] E --> F[Agent tools and routing] ``` ## Before merge - [ ] **Preserve catalog tiered pricing when cost fields are explicit (P2)** - The merge at this point can add a catalog `tieredPricing`, but `costMutated` only compares the four flat rates.
